devdoc.details: Immutable policies; checkpointed transferable shares; voted exact calls; bounded operators; fully funded buyouts. A new, unused Bound account avoids inherited approvals and liabilities. Enumerated fungible balances and ETH are enforced, not a claim of universal DeFi debt detection.
